title: Policy contract
description: What a treatment arm and a control arm actually are. No policy version is ever deleted: the meaning of last year's experiment depends on exactly what its control was. `supersedes` names the predecessor, and a check refuses a chain whose predecessor is not on disk.

allOf.$comment: Doctrine rule 2. A policy that IS the safe state produces prices when everything else has failed, and every one of them must be traceable as a fallback to the label, the P&L and the experiment. Without this, a policy with `safe_state: true` and no `marker` validates and the ladder raises at runtime instead — which is the safe state failing at exactly the moment it is the only thing left standing. `if/then` and not `dependentSchemas`, because the condition is on the VALUE of safe_state and dependentSchemas keys only on a property's presence.

supersedes.description: `<id>@v<n>` of the predecessor, or null for the first version. The named file must exist on disk.

kind.description: `deterministic` means the policy has exactly one correct answer for a given input and no model is consulted. The markdown ladder is the declared safe state of the fresh path, so it must be deterministic or the safe state is not safe.

safe_state.description: Whether this policy is itself the safe state for its path.

marker.description: Doctrine rule 2 — a price produced by a fallback carries this marker to the label, the P&L and the experiment.

depth_pct.description: Reduction from the shelf base price, as a percentage.

when_step_breaches_floor.description: `clamp_to_floor` keeps selling at the lowest legal price; `refuse` stops offering the item, which is a correct output (donation or disposal), not an error.

idempotency_key.description: A decision is idempotent per this key — re-running never produces a second price change.
